files.README.md:
# Triggery — notifications (Vite + Solid)

Same trigger as the React notifications example, Solid components. Demonstrates that the trigger file is framework-agnostic.

## Try it

- **Open in StackBlitz** — <https://triggeryjs.github.io/play/vite-solid-notifications/>
- **Read the recipe** — <https://triggeryjs.github.io/recipes/solid/notification-pipeline/>

Or run it locally:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```
